Bihar Military Police
(Establishment and
Committed
Expenditure)
column7:
Reduction in provision of
₹2,663.32 lakh was the
net effect of increase of
₹5,130.00 lakh and
decrease by re-
appropriation of
₹7,793.32 lakh. Increase
was attributed to need of
additional amounts in
salary, medical
reimbursement, material
and supply and machine
and equipments item.
Decrease was attributed
to anticipated saving.
Reasons for final saving
have not been intimated
(July 2024).
